meta.basis: 7 nights, 2 adults, 1 room, Las Vegas (NV), prices as displayed by Booking.com search results for that exact date range. Booking.com '7 nights' totals generally EXCLUDE the property resort fee and local tax unless the rate block says otherwise; Wynn/Encore property pages quote room + $55/night resort fee but exclude 13.38% tax. Never compare the two bases directly.
meta.room_requirement: Private bathroom AND queen-or-larger (or equivalent). 'king or queen' is satisfied by suites with 1 king + 1 sofa bed.
meta.proximity_rule: michelin_within_60 is the user's literal metric (count of the 24 Michelin restaurants reachable in ≤60 min by RTC bus / Monorail / Vegas Loop). On the Strip it saturates at 24 for every hotel, so michelin_within_20 is used as the ranking tiebreaker. See data/transit.json for the zone matrix — every minute figure is an ESTIMATE derived from official route maps, never an official running time.
meta.cheapest_note: Lowest captured Booking.com 7-night quote in this dataset is LINQ at $564 for 2027-02-15→02-22, but it is a third-party quote, not an official property rate, and is 'Room Type Assigned on Arrival' — the bed size is not guaranteed until check-in. Official direct rates are separately sampled and conflict on date comparisons; see F-29.
meta.housekeeping_note: Hotel rows are unchanged by the 2026-11-25 verification pass; the only structural addition is this note. See FLAGS.md F-21 to F-25 for restaurant-level corrections found in the same pass.
meta.official_link_note: official_verified='yes' means this session fetched the URL and it resolved to the property. 'no' means the URL is the property's own domain but was not fetched, so it may have moved — the Booking.com 'Price source' link on every card is always a fetched, working source.
meta.audit_2026_11_26: Line-by-line audit 2026-11-26 (T12). Venetian rows withdrawn (F-39). Per-night vs 7-night reconciliation failures flagged on every affected row (F-40). Palms Place room specifications flagged (F-41). No other value was changed.
